lesson: Card #9 went 3W-0L for +$45.05 — the best day of the season. All three picks were the same shape: a clear, checkable current-form gap (Roma's unbeaten start, Betis' win over Real Madrid, Braga's home clean-sheet run), not a reputation call. Season record is now 14W-14L, essentially break-even (-6.9% ROI) after ten cards — which is exactly the point: this is still a small sample, and the process matters more than any single day's result in either direction.

matches.analysis: FEATURED MATCH. Valencia are winless in four, have failed to score in three of those four games, and have now lost their last four in a row — including a 0-5 hammering by Barcelona and a 0-1 defeat at Sevilla. This isn't a marginal edge; it's one of the clearest form gaps on the board this season. Alavés are the stronger side at home and the model backs it (54% to 19%).

Ajax's win price is around 1.15 — far too short to back outright, the same trap we avoided with AZ and Twente earlier this season. The better angle: Willem II have conceded in six straight matches, and every one of those six games has produced goals at both ends. Ajax themselves haven't kept a home clean sheet in their last five league matches at the Johan Cruyff Arena. Both attacks are live; Ajax's home defence isn't as tight as their overall form suggests.
Model gives Rayo a moderate edge (41.5% to 30.4%), but without a specific recent-form story behind it the way today's other picks have, this doesn't clear the bar for a stake. Pass.

Real Madrid at 1.27 is far too short to offer any value, regardless of how likely they are to win. Pass on the straight win — nothing else about this fixture stood out enough to research further today.
